dsh-selection-toolbar is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Shows a floating toolbar above text selected in a conversation, with copy, quote, ask, explain, translate, summarize, and custom prompt actions.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-afcab103abb9f8861375.html
